issues.description: Task 10 in the problem statement asks for the IDs of all Radwege that lead to Gemeinden in Oberfranken or Unterfranken, but the provided solution query returns Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.name instead of an ID column. This mismatch between the specification and the solution will confuse students and cause the reference solution/tests to check for the wrong attribute.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify solution_repository/aufgabe10.sql to select the radweg ID column instead of the name (e.g. SELECT Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.radweg_id or SELECT Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.id) while keeping the same FROM and WHERE clauses. Ensure the selected column matches the actual ID column name in the schema so the solution returns IDs as requested.

issues.description: The problem asks for the IDs of Radwege that lead to Gemeinden in Oberfranken or Unterfranken, but the solution selects Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.name (the name) instead of an identifier column. This mismatches the requested conceptual entity (ID vs. name) and will confuse students trying to match the task requirement to the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Return the Radweg identifier column instead of the name. For example: SELECT Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.radweg_id FROM Radweg_zu_Gemeinde, Gemeinde WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.gemeindeschluessel AND (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Oberfranken' OR Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Unterfranken'); (Replace radweg_id with the actual ID column name in the schema if different.)
